The quote you are looking for combines two iconic lines from Ryan Gosling's character, Jared Vennett, in The Big Short: the "match and kerosene" analogy and the famous "stupid vs. illegal" back-and-forth. 
Here are the two exact scenes and quotes you are thinking of: 
1. The "Match and Kerosene" Quote
This is the voiceover where Jared describes the moment Mark Baum (played by Steve Carell) realizes the depth of the impending 2008 financial collapse: 
"If the mortgage bonds were the match, and the CDOs were the kerosene-soaked rags, then the synthetic CDO was the atomic bomb with a drunk president holding his finger over the button. It was at that moment, in that dumb restaurant with that stupid look on his face, that Mark Baum realized the whole world economy might collapse." 
2. The "Stupidity vs. Fraud" Quote
If you are remembering the word "stupidity" specifically mixed into the conversation, it comes from this sharp exchange between Jared and Mark Baum regarding the big banks: 
  • Danny Moses: "How can the banks let this happen?"
  • Jared Vennett: "It's fueled by stupidity."
  • Mark Baum: "But that's not stupidity. That's fraud."
  • Jared Vennett: "Tell me the difference between stupid and illegal and I'll have my wife's brother arrested."
